tasks.title: Monorepo + uv workspace scaffolding
tasks.description: Create the monorepo with a uv workspace containing the six packages (SDK, engine, four connectors) using src layout and shared pyproject conventions. Already in place.
tasks.dod: uv workspace resolves all six packages; `uv sync --all-packages` installs every member and each is importable.
tasks.verify: uv sync --all-packages && uv run python -c 'import qlabs_catalog_sync_sdk, qlabs_catalog_sync'

tasks.title: Tooling config: ruff, mypy strict, pytest, pre-commit
tasks.description: Declare the shared ruff, mypy (strict), pytest and pytest-asyncio configuration in the root pyproject, and wire ruff/mypy/pytest into pre-commit. Already in place; T0.5 makes it pass.
tasks.dod: Shared ruff/mypy/pytest config is declared in the root pyproject and pre-commit wires ruff, mypy and pytest.
tasks.verify: uv run ruff --version && uv run mypy --version && uv run pytest --version

tasks.title: Repair the repository gate (currently red)
tasks.description: The gate does not pass from a clean checkout. Fix four things: (1) the workspace members are not installed by plain `uv sync` - use `uv sync --all-packages` everywhere and commit uv.lock; (2) `ruff check .` lints planning/, which this project's tooling must not touch - exclude it in the ruff config and in the pre-commit hooks; (3) mypy fails with 'Duplicate module named test_smoke' - scope mypy's `files` to the six packages/*/src trees; (4) pytest cannot collect because six packages each carry a test_smoke.py with no package marker - set import-mode=importlib in the pytest config. Do not change any behavior in planning/.
tasks.dod: From a clean checkout `uv sync --all-packages`, `uv run ruff check packages`, `uv run mypy` and `uv run pytest -q` all pass; neither ruff nor mypy reads planning/; uv.lock is committed.
tasks.verify: uv sync --all-packages && uv run ruff check packages && uv run mypy && uv run pytest -q

tasks.title: Pin every runtime dependency up front
tasks.description: Declare and lock every third-party runtime dependency the plan names, in the package that needs it, before any implementation task starts: pydantic v2 and pydantic-settings, httpx, tenacity, sqlalchemy 2, alembic, apscheduler<4, structlog, prometheus-client, databricks-sdk. This exists so that no later task has to edit pyproject.toml or uv.lock - the one file every parallel worktree would otherwise conflict on.
tasks.dod: Every runtime dependency named in the plan is declared in the right package and locked; a fresh `uv sync --all-packages` imports all of them; no downstream task needs to touch packaging metadata.
tasks.verify: uv sync --all-packages && uv run python -c 'import pydantic, pydantic_settings, httpx, tenacity, sqlalchemy, alembic, apscheduler, structlog, prometheus_client, databricks.sdk'

tasks.title: CI pipeline: lint, type-check, test, build wheels
tasks.description: Update the CI workflow to run the corrected gate (`uv sync --all-packages`, ruff over packages only, mypy, pytest) and to build a wheel per package.
tasks.dod: CI runs the corrected gate commands and builds a wheel per package on push; the workflow is green.
tasks.verify: uv sync --all-packages && uv run ruff check packages && uv run mypy && uv run pytest -q

tasks.title: Contributor docs: boundaries & dependency rules
tasks.description: Write the contributor guide covering package boundaries, the connector-depends-only-on-SDK rule, the async convention, and where ADRs live.
tasks.dod: Contributor guide states the package boundaries and the connector->SDK-only dependency rule and points to the ADR location.
tasks.verify: uv run python -c "import pathlib,sys; sys.exit(0 if pathlib.Path('CONTRIBUTING.md').is_file() else 1)"

tasks.title: Neutral model types (pydantic v2)
tasks.description: Define the neutral entities and value types as pydantic v2 models: DataProduct, Dataset, GlossaryTerm, Category, Party, Tag, FieldEnvelope, IdentityRef, FieldDiff, TextField. Follow the RS-03 field tables exactly, including customAttributes round-tripping.
tasks.dod: All neutral entities are defined, validate, and serialize round-trip; mypy strict clean.

tasks.title: Connector ABC + contract types (async, watermark-returning)
tasks.description: Define the Connector ABC and its contract types. Binding shape (decision D8): every method is `async`, and `list_changed` returns `ListChangedResult(changes, next_watermark)` so the engine can commit envelopes and the watermark in one transaction - this overrides the synchronous sketch in RS-08. Also define EntityType, Watermark, ChangeRef, WriteResult, HealthStatus, and a FieldDiff that carries per-field full-replace vs partial-patch intent.
tasks.dod: Connector ABC and all contract types compile, are typed, and a stub subclass can be instantiated; list_changed returns a result object carrying the proposed next watermark.

tasks.title: CapabilityManifest types
tasks.description: Model the capability manifest: EntityCapability (supported, identity_keys, fields), FieldCapability (mode rw/ro/na, writable_via, partial_update), allowed_update_paths for closed path enums like Qlik's, and connector-level concurrency (etag/revision/none).
tasks.dod: Manifest model expresses per-entity/field rw/ro/na, partial_update, allowed_update_paths and concurrency; validates.

tasks.title: HTTP helper + retry/backoff + pagination
tasks.description: Async httpx wrapper with base URL, auth injection, timeouts and connection pooling; tenacity retry honoring 429/Retry-After and 5xx with jitter; cursor and offset pagination helpers returning async iterators.
tasks.dod: HTTP helper retries on 429 honoring Retry-After, retries 5xx with jitter, and paginates both cursor and offset styles; covered by respx unit tests.

tasks.title: Auth providers base
tasks.description: AuthProvider base plus API-key, OAuth2 M2M (client credentials) and JWT/key-pair providers, with an in-memory token cache that refreshes before expiry. Tokens are never persisted.
tasks.dod: API-key, OAuth2 M2M and JWT/key-pair providers issue and refresh cached tokens; unit tested; no token is written to disk.

tasks.title: Field envelope + canonical checksum utilities
tasks.description: Envelope construction and a canonical checksum: deterministic normalization of key order, whitespace, timezone representation and array ordering so the same logical value always hashes identically. This is what makes idempotency and no-op re-runs real.
tasks.dod: Checksum is stable across reordering, whitespace and timezone formatting; identical logical values produce identical checksums; differing values never collide in the test corpus.

tasks.title: Config base + ConnectorContext + typed exceptions + secret redaction
tasks.description: ConnectorConfig (pydantic-settings) base, ConnectorContext (resolved config, bound structlog logger, metrics handle, clock), the typed exception hierarchy (TransientError, AuthError, NotFound, ConflictError, CapabilityError), and a structlog processor that redacts secrets.
tasks.dod: Config base loads from env, ConnectorContext is wired, all typed exceptions are defined and raisable, and the redaction processor drops known secret keys from log output.

tasks.title: FakeConnector test double shipped from the SDK
tasks.description: An in-memory connector with a configurable capability manifest, deterministic clock and recorded call log, exported from the SDK. The conformance kit tests itself against it and every engine test uses it, so the engine never needs a real connector to be exercised.
tasks.dod: FakeConnector supports read and write modes, honors its declared manifest, and is importable from the SDK's public surface.

tasks.title: Conformance test kit
tasks.description: Reusable pytest suite connector authors run to certify a connector: contract completeness, round-trip, idempotency, HTTP behavior (429/Retry-After, if-match when concurrency != none), and capability honesty (writing a ro/na field raises CapabilityError instead of calling the API). Ships with the respx/vcr harness.
tasks.dod: Conformance kit runs green against FakeConnector in both read and write modes and fails a deliberately dishonest manifest.

tasks.title: Contract version + compatibility gate + public surface
tasks.description: Export SDK_CONTRACT_VERSION and the entry-point group constant, implement the compatibility gate the engine calls at discovery, and re-export the public surface (models, Connector, manifest types, helpers, exceptions) from the package root.
tasks.dod: Contract version constant is exported, the compatibility gate rejects a mismatched major with a clear message, and the public surface imports cleanly.

tasks.title: Entry-point discovery + connector registry + version gate
tasks.description: Enumerate the qlabs_catalog_sync.connectors entry-point group, version-gate each class through the SDK compatibility gate, register by entry-point name, and fail startup with both distribution names on a name collision.
tasks.dod: Engine discovers connectors via entry points, registers them by name, rejects an incompatible SDK major, and errors clearly on duplicate names.

tasks.title: State store: SQLAlchemy models + Alembic on SQLite
tasks.description: SQLAlchemy 2.0 models and the initial Alembic migration for identity_map, watermarks, field_envelopes and an orphan log, on SQLite in WAL mode. This is the only task that owns the schema - no other task may add a migration.
tasks.dod: Models for identity map, watermarks, envelopes and orphans migrate cleanly on SQLite via Alembic; a round-trip write/read of each table passes.

tasks.title: Config & secrets loading, including the sync-pair schema
tasks.description: Engine configuration via pydantic-settings: endpoints and their credentials (resolved through a secret-backend abstraction), plus the sync-pair schema that is the user-facing contract of the MVP - source endpoint, Unity Catalog catalog.schema selector patterns, target Qlik space, entity types, cadence, manual-edit policy, and the activation opt-in flag.
tasks.dod: Engine loads endpoint config, resolves secrets from a configured backend, and validates a sync-pair definition including UC selector patterns and the target space; invalid config fails at startup with a precise message.

tasks.title: Upstream sync loop (single transaction, idempotent)
tasks.description: The canonical cycle: list_changed on the source -> read to envelopes -> identity resolve -> checksum diff against last-known envelopes -> write to Qlik -> persist envelopes and advance the watermark in ONE transaction. Unchanged checksums short-circuit before any write. A cycle that fails part way commits nothing and leaves the watermark where it was. Exercise it against FakeConnector.
tasks.dod: One cycle reads, resolves, diffs, writes, persists and advances the watermark transactionally; a re-run performs zero writes; a simulated mid-cycle failure leaves state and watermark untouched.

tasks.title: Manual-edit-on-Qlik policy
tasks.description: The only conflict handling in v1: when the Qlik-side value differs from the last synced envelope, apply source-wins overwrite by default, or preserve the local edit when configured, per field and per entity type.
tasks.dod: Policy resolves a manually edited target field per configuration: source-wins by default, preserve-local when set; both paths are covered by tests.

tasks.title: Scheduler: APScheduler async, per-pair cadence
tasks.description: APScheduler 3.11 AsyncIOScheduler running one job per sync pair with configured cadence, jitter so pairs do not fire together, and max_instances=1 so a slow cycle never overlaps itself.
tasks.dod: Per-pair jobs run on cadence with jitter and never overlap; a long-running cycle causes the next trigger to be skipped rather than queued.

tasks.title: Observability: structlog + prometheus + healthz/metrics
tasks.description: Context-bound structured logging (pair, endpoint, entity, neutral_id), Prometheus counters and histograms for cycle latency, reads, planned writes, applied writes, skips, 429s and errors, and a small HTTP surface exposing /healthz and /metrics.
tasks.dod: Structured logs carry sync context and no secrets; /healthz and /metrics respond and expose the sync metrics.

tasks.title: CLI + dry-run mode emitting a reviewable plan
tasks.description: Replace the cli.py stub with a cli package exposing `run`, `dry-run` and `identity-confirm`. Dry-run computes the full planned write set and emits it both as a human-readable log and as a machine-readable JSON plan file, and performs zero mutations against Qlik.
tasks.dod: Dry-run writes a JSON plan describing every intended create/update with its field-level diff and applies nothing; the CLI exposes run, dry-run and identity-confirm.

tasks.title: Orphan policy: report, never delete
tasks.description: Decision D4: when a previously synced source object no longer appears in list_changed or read, record it in the orphan log and surface it in the run report. The engine has no code path that deletes or deactivates a Qlik object in v1.
tasks.dod: A vanished source object is logged as an orphan and reported; a test asserts the engine issues no delete or deactivate call in any code path.

tasks.title: Qlik auth (OAuth2 M2M) + connector setup
tasks.description: The Qlik connector class, its ConfigModel (tenant base URL, OAuth2 M2M client credentials, target space), setup() building the SDK HttpEndpoint with the OAuth2 provider, and healthcheck().
tasks.dod: Connector authenticates to a Qlik tenant via OAuth2 M2M against the configured base URL and healthcheck reports status; unit tested with respx.

tasks.title: Qlik capability manifest
tasks.description: Declare the manifest honestly: data product and dataset entities, per-field rw/ro/na, product arrays partial_update=false, the closed eight-value JSON Patch path enum as allowed_update_paths, concurrency=etag, and glossary entities declared unsupported in v1 (decision D5).
tasks.dod: Manifest declares the rw data-product fields, ETag concurrency, partial_update=false for arrays, the exact PATCH path enum, and glossary unsupported.

tasks.title: read() Qlik entities into neutral envelopes
tasks.description: Read current Qlik state so the engine can diff against it: data products from the data-governance API and datasets from the Items API, paging defensively and capturing secureQri from resourceAttributes plus the ETag for later if-match writes.
tasks.dod: read() returns current Qlik data products and datasets as neutral entities with field envelopes, secureQri, and the last-seen ETag.

tasks.title: Qlik reference resolution: datasets and users
tasks.description: Decisions D2 and D3. Resolve a product's member datasets against datasets that already exist in the target space - IdentityMap first, then name match within the space - and never create one. Resolve owner emails to Qlik userIds through the users API. Cache both. Every unresolved member and every unmatched owner is reported, not silently dropped.
tasks.dod: Dataset members resolve to existing Qlik dataset ids or are reported unresolved; owner emails resolve to Qlik userIds or are reported unmatched; no code path creates a Qlik dataset.

tasks.title: create() data products
tasks.description: POST a data product from a neutral entity: name, description, readMe, tags, spaceId, resolved datasetIds, apiConsumableDatasetIds (must be a subset of datasetIds), and keyContacts (one entry per userId). Enforce the documented caps (100 datasetIds, 100 glossaryIds) before calling.
tasks.dod: create() posts a valid Qlik data-product payload from a neutral entity, enforces the subset and cap rules client-side, and returns the assigned IdentityRef.

tasks.title: update() via JSON Patch (replace-only, ETag, batching)
tasks.description: Translate a FieldDiff into a Qlik JSON Patch: op=replace only, path restricted to the closed eight-value enum, arrays sent whole (full replace) even when one element changed, if-match with the last-seen ETag, at most 8 operations per request, and a 412 handled as re-read, re-diff, re-apply. Fields outside the enum are refused with CapabilityError, never silently skipped.
tasks.dod: update() issues replace-only JSON Patch honoring the path enum, full-replace arrays, if-match and 8-op batching; a 412 triggers exactly one re-read/re-diff cycle; an out-of-enum path raises CapabilityError.

tasks.title: Lifecycle actions + delete() for contract completeness
tasks.description: Implement activate, deactivate, move and delete against the data-governance actions endpoints so the contract and the conformance kit are complete. Per decision D4 the engine calls none of the destructive ones in v1; guard them behind an explicit opt-in flag.
tasks.dod: activate/deactivate/move/delete execute against the documented endpoints and are covered by tests; each destructive call requires an explicit opt-in flag that is off by default.

tasks.title: Qlik conformance tests (respx + vcr)
tasks.description: Run the SDK conformance kit against the Qlik connector in write mode, with respx unit mocks and hand-authored vcr cassettes derived from the documented payloads in the RS-02 reference and readiness note. No live tenant is available.
tasks.dod: The Qlik connector passes the SDK conformance kit in write mode against respx mocks and recorded cassettes.

tasks.title: Databricks auth (OAuth M2M) + client config
tasks.description: The Databricks connector class, its ConfigModel (workspace host, OAuth M2M service-principal credentials, optional sql_warehouse_id), setup() building the databricks-sdk WorkspaceClient, and healthcheck().
tasks.dod: Connector authenticates to Databricks via OAuth M2M with a configured workspace client and healthcheck reports status.

tasks.title: Databricks capability manifest
tasks.description: Declare read-only capability honestly: DataProduct (from a UC schema) and Dataset (table/view) supported, identity keys full_name plus object id, glossary na, concurrency none, and - per decision D6 - tags declared supported only when a sql_warehouse_id is configured, otherwise na. No write path is declared for any field.
tasks.dod: Manifest declares read-only entities, full_name+object_id identity, glossary na, concurrency none, and tags conditional on a configured SQL warehouse.

tasks.title: Databricks list_changed
tasks.description: Return candidates changed since the watermark using UC updated_at on schemas and tables, with a snapshot-checksum comparison as the fallback where updated_at is unreliable, and return the proposed next watermark alongside the changes.
tasks.dod: list_changed returns entities changed since the watermark plus a proposed next watermark; a re-run with the returned watermark yields no candidates.

tasks.title: Databricks read(): UC schema as data product
tasks.description: Decision D1: read a Unity Catalog schema as a DataProduct and the tables and views inside it as its Datasets, paging over /api/2.1/unity-catalog/schemas and /tables and honoring the configured catalog.schema selector patterns.
tasks.dod: read() returns a UC schema as a neutral DataProduct with its tables/views as member Datasets, with field envelopes, paging defensively.

tasks.title: Databricks source-to-neutral mapping
tasks.description: Map the UC metadata surface onto neutral fields: comment -> description, owner -> Party (email or service-principal application id), full_name -> physicalRef, properties -> customAttributes, table_type -> assetType. Read-only fields (lineage, audit stamps, generated identifiers) are carried as ro or dropped, never as write targets.
tasks.dod: Comments, owners, physical names and properties map into the correct neutral fields; read-only fields are never emitted as writable.

tasks.title: Databricks tag read path over the Statement Execution API
tasks.description: Decision D6: UC object tags are only readable through INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMA_TAGS and TABLE_TAGS, which means SQL. Read them over the Statement Execution API when a sql_warehouse_id is configured; when it is not, the connector reports tags as unavailable and the manifest says na.
tasks.dod: With a warehouse configured, schema and table tags are read into neutral Tag values; without one, tags are absent and the manifest reports na - and a test asserts both branches.

tasks.title: Databricks conformance tests (respx + vcr)
tasks.description: Run the SDK conformance kit against the Databricks connector in read mode with respx mocks and hand-authored cassettes, including the capability-honesty check that no write path exists.
tasks.dod: The Databricks connector passes the SDK conformance kit in read mode, and attempting any write raises CapabilityError without issuing a request.

tasks.title: IdentityMap store + bootstrap matching
tasks.description: Identity resolution over the state store: look up neutralId by source native key; on first encounter bootstrap-match against Qlik candidates by natural key (name + type + parent path), write the proposal to a review file, and bind only after explicit confirmation. After binding, match by the stored map alone. Expose confirm and list operations as a callable API the CLI wraps.
tasks.dod: Bootstrap proposes matches by natural key and binds none without confirmation; confirmed matches persist and are reused; an ambiguous match is reported rather than guessed.

tasks.title: Field diff engine
tasks.description: Compute the minimal set of field mutations from source envelopes against last-known target envelopes, then shape it per the target's capability manifest: widen a partial change to a full array when partial_update is false, refuse fields outside allowed_update_paths, and never emit a field the manifest marks ro or na.
tasks.dod: Diff emits minimal mutations, widens arrays where partial_update is false, drops ro/na fields, and produces an empty diff for identical checksums.

tasks.title: Owner/Party best-effort email correlation
tasks.description: Correlate owners across endpoints on email as plain metadata, with no correctness guarantee and no identity-resolution machinery. Unmatched owners are reported and dropped.
tasks.dod: Owners correlate on email as plain metadata; unmatched owners are reported; no code path treats a correlation as an authorization decision.

tasks.title: Neutral status -> Qlik activation reconciliation
tasks.description: Decision D7: neutral status active corresponds to an activated Qlik data product (managed space only); every other status leaves it deactivated. Activation is opt-in per pair and off by default because it makes a product discoverable tenant-wide.
tasks.dod: Neutral status maps to the correct Qlik lifecycle action; with activation opt-in off, no activate call is ever issued.

tasks.title: Databricks -> Qlik end-to-end pilot (against mocks)
tasks.description: The integration proof: one Unity Catalog schema with its tables becomes one Qlik data product. Run dry-run, assert the emitted JSON plan, then apply and assert the resulting Qlik payloads. Runs entirely against respx mocks and cassettes - no live tenant is available for this build.
tasks.dod: One Databricks UC schema syncs to one Qlik data product in dry-run then apply, and the applied requests match the expected payloads field for field.

tasks.title: Idempotency + restart-safety tests
tasks.description: Prove the properties the design claims: re-running a synced product issues zero writes; a crash between write and commit re-runs safely and no-ops; the engine resumes from the persisted watermark; a failed cycle commits nothing.
tasks.dod: Re-run is a zero-write no-op, a simulated crash mid-cycle leaves state and watermark untouched, and restart resumes from the persisted watermark.

tasks.title: VCR contract tests for both connectors
tasks.description: Freeze the expected request and response shapes for the Qlik and Databricks connectors as vcr cassettes, so an upstream API change surfaces as a failing test rather than a silent data loss.
tasks.dod: Both connectors pass contract tests against recorded cassettes, and a deliberately altered cassette fails the suite.

tasks.title: Tenant-verification package (registry + probe + checklist)
tasks.description: No live tenant is available during this build, so every behavior that only a real tenant can confirm is registered rather than assumed: a TENANT_UNVERIFIED registry in the Qlik connector naming each assumption and where it is relied on, a runnable scripts/tenant_probe.py that exercises them against a real tenant, and a checklist a human runs before production. Cover the glossary PATCH path enum, the change-status body key, the links payload, whether data-products PATCH honors if-match, qri stability across a space move, and the required role strings.
tasks.dod: Every unverified behavior is listed in the registry with its call site, the probe script runs against a tenant from config, and the checklist maps each item to a pass/fail step.

tasks.title: Containerize the service
tasks.description: One image, one long-running process: load and validate config, open the state store, register per-pair jobs, expose /healthz and /metrics.
tasks.dod: The container builds and runs the sync service as a single long-running process against a mounted config.

tasks.title: Config + secret templates per tenant
tasks.description: Per-tenant configuration and secret templates, plus the wiring for the secret backend (env first, with the provider abstraction in place for a manager).
tasks.dod: A per-tenant config and secret template exist and load through the configured secret backend without any secret in the repository.

tasks.title: Cadence + rate-limit budgeting defaults
tasks.description: Ship sensible defaults: data-product metadata every 5-15 minutes, larger dataset scans every 30-60 minutes, jitter on, and a per-endpoint request budget that lengthens cadence under sustained 429s.
tasks.dod: Default per-pair cadence and per-endpoint rate-limit budgets are configured, applied by the scheduler, and documented.

tasks.title: Runbook + generated capability matrix + tag v0.1
tasks.description: Operator runbook (deploy, configure a pair, run dry-run, read the plan file, confirm identity matches, read the orphan report, respond to a red healthcheck) plus a capability matrix generated from the connector manifests so it cannot drift, then tag v0.1.
tasks.dod: The runbook covers deploy, configure, dry-run, confirm, and troubleshoot; the capability matrix is generated from the live manifests; v0.1 is tagged.
